description: Cao Cao, commanding chinese warlord in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in a topknot with a small gold crown, black armor with gold trim, long red cape, black boots. He holds a straight sword in the right hand
face: Sharp stern eyes, black moustache and a short black beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: black hair with the gold crown, the long red cape covering the whole back down to the calves, the sword at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Commander ready stance with a one-handed sword, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a2: Command with the sword raised. Frames 1-6 he lifts the sword high above his head; frame 8 he holds it at the top, calling the order; frames 9-11 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Direct diagonal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is raised to the upper right; frames 6-8 a big step forward and a cut from upper right to lower left; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Direct thrust. Frames 1-5 the sword is drawn back beside the hip; frames 6-8 a big step forward and a straight thrust, point first; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Overwhelming command. Frames 1-6 he sinks, winds the upper body back and raises the LEFT arm high above his head; frame 8 he drives the body upright and sweeps chest and arm forward and down in one grand gesture, sword pointing forward; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b1: Left-hand signal. The sword stays low at the right side. Frames 1-6 the LEFT arm winds back; frame 8 the left hand is thrown forward, palm out, giving the signal; frames 9-11 hold. Nothing is struck.
actions.b2: Level command. The sword is swept out level from the left to the front in a wide arc and stops pointing at the target; he holds the point on it.

notes: 2026-11-19. 평타 a2(호령) → a3(직접 베기) → b3(직접 찌르기), 전법 s1(위무지세). 검 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px).
